What comes with DBGL Extended Edition, and under which license
==============================================================

DBGL Extended Edition itself
  GNU General Public License version 2 or later - see COPYING in the main
  folder. Source: https://github.com/mrmercy82/dbgl-extended-edition
  Based on DBGL 0.100 beta 17 by Ronald Blankendaal, https://dbgl.org
  The FAT image reader in it comes from fat32-lib (JNode.org, Matthias
  Treydte), GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1 or later.

The files in this folder are the license texts as they come inside the
libraries (one folder per library), copied here so they can be read without
unpacking the jar files.

lib/swt*.jar - Eclipse SWT (Standard Widget Toolkit) 4.41
  Eclipse Public License 2.0; parts under other licenses, see about.html
  and about_files. https://www.eclipse.org/swt/
lib/gallery_*.jar - Eclipse Nebula Gallery widget 1.1.0
  Eclipse Public License 2.0, see about.html. https://eclipse.dev/nebula/
lib/commons-io-*.jar, commons-lang3-*.jar, commons-text-*.jar - Apache Commons
  Apache License 2.0, see LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt.
  https://commons.apache.org/
lib/jersey-*.jar - Eclipse Jersey (with the libraries bundled into it)
  Eclipse Public License 2.0 or GPL 2 with Classpath Exception; parts under
  other licenses, see LICENSE.md and NOTICE.md.
  https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey/
lib/jsoup-*.jar - jsoup
  MIT License, see LICENSE. https://jsoup.org/license
lib/hsqldb-*.jar - HSQLDB (HyperSQL)
  HSQLDB license (a BSD-style license). The jar does not carry the text;
  it is at https://hsqldb.org/web/hsqlLicense.html
lib/json-*.jar - JSON-java (org.json)
  Public Domain. The jar does not carry the text; it is at
  https://github.com/stleary/JSON-java/blob/master/LICENSE

Windows package only:
DOSBox-0.74-3 - DOSBox 0.74-3 by the DOSBox Team, with SDL and SDL_net
  GNU General Public License version 2 or later, see
  DOSBox-0.74-3/Documentation/COPYING.txt. https://www.dosbox.com/
  SDL and SDL_net: GNU Lesser General Public License, https://www.libsdl.org/
launch.exe - made with Launch4j, https://launch4j.sourceforge.net/
jre - (package with Java) Eclipse Temurin 21 (Java runtime) by the Eclipse
  Adoptium project,
  GNU General Public License version 2 with the Classpath Exception, see
  jre/NOTICE and the folder jre/legal. https://adoptium.net/

macOS packages only:
DBGL.app/Contents/Resources/DOSBox.app - DOSBox 0.74-3 by the DOSBox Team
  GNU General Public License version 2 or later, see the file "License"
  in DBGL.app/Contents/Resources. https://www.dosbox.com/

db/mobygames.* - a database of game information, as it comes with DBGL
  0.100 beta 17 (used to look up games without the internet).
